systems.system: National repertoire of natural and legal persons holding the Numéro d'Identification Nationale and the identity data kept up to date with it
systems.owner: service national chargé de la statistique

note: The 2006 decree applying the national identification number; it obliges the declaration centres of mairies to send civil status, nationality and domicile changes to the national statistics service within 30 days, and leaves the technical form of the transfer to that service. A legal duty only: no connection of any local government office is stated.
